overview.description: The FT Vest DJIA Dogs 10 Target Income ETF (DOGG) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in income alternatives. The fund seeks to provide a consistent level of income with a secondary objective of providing capital appreciation. The fund invests in a concentrated portfolio of equally weighted, high dividend-yielding, large-cap US stocks, options, and short-term Treasury securities. DOGG was launched on Apr 26, 2023 and is issued by First Trust.
